title: Vanilla Pod Crème Brûlée with Demerara Crust
summary: Silky baked vanilla custards topped with a shatteringly crisp layer of caramelised demerara sugar.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Set 6 ramekins in a roasting tin lined with a folded tea towel and boil a kettle.

steps.title: Infuse
steps.text: Split a vanilla pod, scrape the seeds into a saucepan with the pod, 240 ml cream, 100 g sugar and a pinch of salt, bring to a bare simmer, then cover and steep 15 min.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Remove the pod, stir in 480 ml cold cream, then whisk in 9 egg yolks and slowly combine with the warm cream.

steps.title: Strain
steps.text: Pass the custard through a sieve and divide among the ramekins.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Pour boiling water into the tin to come two-thirds up the ramekins and bake at 150 °C until the centres reach 77-79 °C, 30-35 min.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Cool the ramekins 2 h, then cover and chill at least 4 h.

steps.title: Caramelise
steps.text: Sprinkle 1 tsp demerara sugar over each custard and caramelise with a blowtorch until deep amber.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Chill 30-45 min to re-firm, then serve within an hour.

tips: Whisk the yolks gently rather than vigorously so you don't introduce too much foam into the custard.
Check the custards with a thermometer, as they should still have a slight wobble when they come out of the oven.
Blot any surface moisture from the chilled custards before adding sugar so it caramelises evenly.
storage: Chill the baked custards for at least 4 hours before caramelising, and serve within an hour of torching so the sugar crust stays crisp.
